title: Costa Fortune | KEY.co
description_expanded: Outdoor living is equally impressive, highlighted by a Gulf-facing resort-style pool, summer kitchen, and spacious terraces perfectly positioned for sunset views over the water. Accommodations include beautifully appointed king suites, a fun bunk room ideal for larger groups, and a luxurious primary suite with a private balcony and spa-inspired bath featuring a soaking tub and expansive shower. A separate carriage house adds additional privacy with two bedrooms, a full kitchen, and a comfortable living area. With six adult bikes, a six-seater golf cart, and effortless access to miles of pristine white sand beach, this extraordinary coastal estate offers a truly elevated setting for unforgettable gatherings by the sea. Perched directly on the Gulf with private beach access, this remarkable nine-bedroom, nine-bath retreat blends coastal beauty with refined comfort across multiple thoughtfully designed levels. Expansive living spaces are filled with natural light and sweeping Gulf views, creating an atmosphere that is both elegant and relaxed. The main level features a stunning chef’s kitchen with premium appliances, generous island seating, and a dining area designed for memorable gatherings. Entertainment flows effortlessly throughout the home with a game room, a private theater, multiple wet bars, and inviting lounge areas, while an elevator provides convenient access to every floor.
